# FDG9136

> CONSIDER applying the `ContentPropertyAttribute` to enable convenient XAML syntax for the most commonly used property.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.11 XAML Readable Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: which property is the most commonly used one is design.

## From the book

```csharp
[ContentProperty("Image")]
public class Button {
  public object Image { get; set; }
}
```

The following XAML syntax would work without the attribute:

```csharp
<Button>
  <Button.Image>
    <Image Source="foo.jpg" />
  </Button.Image>
</Button>
```

The attribute makes the following much more readable syntax possible.

```csharp
<Button>
  <Image Source="foo.jpg" />
</Button>
```
